description: A caller-supplied policy that itself raises. The instance policy is throw-in-policy with a fixed message and the instance handler is return-key. DefaultStrings.java:734-735 calls shouldTryNextLocale OUTSIDE the try block that guards getInternal, so the exception is not converted into a RESOLUTION_FAILURE and not recoverable by fallback: it leaves getResult entirely, before the failure handler at :747 is ever consulted. FALLBACK LOCALE fr gives the same four-candidate [en-GB, en-001, en, fr] shape as custom-policy-four-candidate-chain (with fallbackLocale en the chain is three long and fr is unreachable, which would make the neutralized-policy case assert a walk that cannot happen), so the throw occurs at the FIRST consultation and the message identifies which policy fired. Throwing.Present exists only at en-GB, giving a control in which the walk returns before any consultation; Throwing.OnlyInFallback is served by the last candidate once the policy is replaced; Throwing.MissingEverywhere is served by none. Three loaded locales share the primary language en, so tiebreakers lists that exact permutation.

en-GB.Throwing.Present: en-GB: present at the first candidate

fr.Throwing.OnlyInFallback: fr: only the fallback catalog has this
